# tabled

> A (key-value) data-object-layer to get (pandas) tables from a variety of sources with ease


## Pages in this subsection

- [tabled](tabled.html.md): A data-object-layer package for accessing pandas DataFrames from various sources.
- [tabled.base](tabled.base.html.md): Based functionality for tabled
- [tabled.coerce](tabled.coerce.html.md): Column type coercion utilities for pandas DataFrames.
- [tabled.compare_tables](tabled.compare_tables.html.md): Tools to compare tables
- [tabled.diagnose](tabled.diagnose.html.md): DataFrame and table collection diagnosis utilities.
- [tabled.html](tabled.html.html.md): To work with html
- [tabled.join_tables](tabled.join_tables.html.md): Join multiple tables (pandas DataFrames) down to a target subset of columns.
- [tabled.misc](tabled.misc.html.md): Miscellaneous utility functions for tables.
- [tabled.multi](tabled.multi.html.md): Multi-tabled data structures.
- [tabled.sqlite_tools](tabled.sqlite_tools.html.md): General-purpose SQLite to DataFrame/Parquet export tools using DuckDB.
- [tabled.tools](tabled.tools.html.md): Various high-level tools using tabled
- [tabled.util](tabled.util.html.md): General-purpose utilities for working with DataFrames, dicts, and byte decoding.
- [tabled.wrappers](tabled.wrappers.html.md): Wrapping tools
